# Preservation checkpoint — October 17, 2026

This is the current checkpoint; older sections below are historical, dated slices. Cloud Linux/bashed workspace `/workspace/asset-production`, separate from the Mac app. No new image generation is running. Eleven actual native image calls produced 57 drawings; zero local batches are staged/integrated into Mac or accepted as production art, and zero cross-clip reuses are verified. Reviewed means findings exist, not approval. Nine external demo clips were observed via parent relay only; their precise Mac build/receipt is still pending.

All current originals, exact prompts, frames, derived clips, rejected experiments, findings and source/docs are retained by the existing split Library packs plus updated Tracker Records. Five newer manifests and two inspection PNGs supplement prior immutable packs. `preservation-file-inventory.json` gives file hashes and exact archive coverage; `preservation-checkpoint.json` gives every durable delivered identity, execution environment, scope and remaining blockers. Library checks establish metadata existence/size plus local ZIP/member hashes; remote binary bytes were not re-downloaded.

The 7-question / 11-fixture / 12-failure-class contract evidence packet is `[private-source-reference-retained-locally]`, local `delivery/ChirpNeighbors-Contract-Review-Evidence.zip`. Its 24 integrity checks passed. It is an unagreed proposal with static evidence expectations, not a runtime schema, physics solver or conformance pass. Mac implementation is frozen for independent audit. Direct delivery to the Mac owner/auditor is blocked by unavailable cross-thread tools; parent relay and acknowledgment remain pending. No further perch generation before geometry agreement.

Owner authorization now permits commit/push/merge. Neither stale cloud source checkout has been edited, and no Git mutation was performed: producer artifacts are outside those repos, source/docs placement must be coordinated with the Mac owner, and large binaries remain Library deliveries. This is a coordination blocker, not an approval denial. No personal data, recordings, databases or credentials are in these deliverables.

Next queued actions: relay the packet and obtain contract decisions; coordinate Git placement with the Mac owner; review existing finch perch/feed contacts and event bindings after geometry/scale agreement. These are queued and blocked, with no background worker implied.

---

# Latest slice: House Finch + deliverable split

Five new native image calls produced26 House Finch drawings: two text-grounded male/female canon candidates and four six-pose idle/seed-feeding clips. Exact prompts, originals, source references and call receipts are retained. Licensed photo metadata was verified, but photo bytes were blocked by the proxy; no photo conditioning is claimed. Species morphology/style and biological scale remain unaccepted.

Frame isolation preserves every atlas pixel with alpha>=2 exactly once; alpha1 residue is excluded only from derivative frames. Original source PNGs are unchanged. Root/feet/beak annotations are provisional pixel heuristics, not anatomical tracking. Each normalized source frame is1024px; review/intake derivatives use one uniform0.375 scale to384px. No per-frame fitting or body deformation. Native source is not an accepted app wire profile.

The single local `frame-bank.json` now has56 content-addressed immutable frame records. Clip manifests reference frame IDs; generated image files are stored once, with independent review derivatives. Per-delivery frame-bank projections are subsets of that register, not new authorities. Reuse suggestions are not verified. `lessons-and-experiments.json` records working methods, failed hypotheses, exact source/prompt links and next changes. Sequence failure does not automatically discard every frame.

Deliverability: the preserved44.5MB combined checkpoint exceeded the parent's attachment limit. It was split into a standalone self-contained1.14MB tracker (embedded GIFs), records0.47MB, and prior source packs7.3–12.5MB. New House Finch packs are3.3–7.5MB each. Canonical Library identities for split tracker/records are retained and updated rather than creating parallel queues. The combined archive and its original SHA are preserved.

Parent reports Mac browser observation of nine jay/cardinal clips/54 drawings, a single0.5mL drinking transfer and unchanged Alice saved layout. This is relayed observed-demo integration, not production art approval; exact source version/QA receipt requested. House Finch and dove are not thereby integrated. Shared canonical IDs/contracts and dove intake remain Mac-owned and pending receipt.

No House Finch image call is running at this checkpoint. Next concrete queue: perching reuse validation from compatible idle frames (zero planned new image calls), then targeted feeding contact/prop-size review after accepted world scale. No further unrelated rain generation. Ordinary walk-hop should remain upright with modest steps/bounce, distinct from takeoff/startle; natural amplitude is a separate acceptance gate.

# Current production handoff — October17, 14:16UTC

Five actual native OpenAI image calls produced30 drawings: dove walk/drink, understory wind, rain v1 and rain v2. Five packages have exact-crop, unique-frame and6-frame APNG/GIF decode verification. Rain v2 FAILED requested temporal continuity (mean shifted-alpha-mask IoU0.051; loopedge0.0); it is preserved as a failed correction, not accepted smoother rain. All art remains candidate/review-only.

`queue.json` is a derived operational snapshot. Source-owned requirement, regional and fact catalogs are referenced by Library identity and retained read snapshots; this is not the shared app catalog. `production-handoff.json` is a versioned PROPOSAL for bounded production receipts, with canonical species/family/clip IDs explicitly null until the Mac task agrees its typed interchange. No app, database, resident, observation or layout data was changed.

Sourced regional proposal:42 birds/63 plants; proposed first complete San Diego release18 birds and37 plants. These counts describe scope, not completed assets. Twenty source-cited fact cards now populate the optional local Learn preview. Calls and audio license evidence remain absent. Published measurement endpoints are unspecified; point measurements remain points, dove sex-specific values and Bushtit conflicts are retained. Every species has an unresolved scale-calibration record across its clips; fixed source canvas is not biological scale.

Queries use the same queue snapshot: `python3 query_gaps.py --pack san-diego --missing scale --limit 10`; gaps are clips/facts/license/scale/review/runtime/integration. `tracker.html` exposes corresponding pack/gap filters and sourced card/scale preview. Body/gaze direction and season/health/layer decompositions remain proposals. Current local runtime snapshot admits nine keys; its schema and catalog may lag Mac.

Parent deliveries are retained as Library references and labelled metadata/relay evidence; their bytes were not independently inspected here. This includes jay, cardinal, botanical and corvid bundles. Crow v1 was owner-rejected; v2 palette improvement is parent-measured, gait remains weak; v3 failed acceptance. Botanical root/IoU caveats remain open.

No image call or hidden background worker is running at this handoff. Next work: Mac weather-compositor decision after failed rain phase conditioning; canonical dove-reference/contact review; typed ID/slot/pack agreement and staged-route receipt. No publish, commit or push was performed.

---

# ChirpNeighbors private asset production

This directory is the production handoff, separate from both October 12 repository snapshots and the Mac implementation. Nothing here is published, pushed, selected in the app, or claimed integrated.

`queue.json` is the single queue. States: queued → generating → generated → reviewed → staged → integrated. Review records may reject a batch; state alone never means accepted. External parent-reported counts are distinct from locally verified files.

Original model outputs and exact prompts are retained for every successful call. Derivative frames, timing, anchors, hashes, reviews and playable previews are produced from actual output pixels. Registration is not new body animation. No frame is synthesized through runtime bobbing.

Current local contracts: UI 6f23d988a788a29de509f92af7c1f24f7e63c6b4 and main b73abeaa06d7ecb67850dc9da8492090890729eb, both October 12. V4 source density supports 1/2/4 source pixels per world unit; source canvas edge ≤256; total decoded animation pixels ≤65,536; ≤64 colors; binary alpha; ≤64 frames. High-resolution staged candidates do not automatically satisfy these limits. The Mac task owns any updated profile or app integration.

Library access: metadata works; all six source-byte downloads failed. See the failure receipt. Existing packs remain candidates, with no invented hashes or review approvals.

## Previous four-call checkpoint

Four real OpenAI image calls produced 24 unique source drawings: dove walk, dove drinking, understory wind and rain overlay. Every batch contains original output, exact prompt, separate source PNG frames, uniform384px review derivatives, atlas, APNG, GIF, contact sheet, timing/anchors manifest and explicit review caveats. Source frames are768px for registered birds/plant and512px for rain. The384px derivatives use a single scale per set; they are not automatically compatible with the older app contract. Relative bird physical scale remains uncalibrated.

`queue.json` is the single operational data source. `requirements-source.json` is a read-derived snapshot of the parent's canonical Library requirement inventory (`[private-source-reference-retained-locally]`, parent-reported version1), not a second requirement authority. `build_tracker.py` reconciles requirements/contract facts and generates `tracker.html` from this queue. The HTML includes its JSON snapshot for inspectability and runs without a build. Serve this directory on loopback if managed browser policy blocks file URLs. The HTML is a local review artifact; it is not a published Site or the ChirpNeighbors app.

The tracker has1,344 bird rows (8 species ×28 requested/runtime actions ×6 proposed directions),155 plant state/layer/interaction rows,19 existing scene-asset records and18 weather/water slots. These are proposed coverage decompositions, not accepted roster/frame requirements. Required frame counts remain unknown; initial six-frame plans are labelled proposals. Mirrored views are not counted as new generated drawings. Biological applicability stays pending.

San Diego/Southern California is the first regional-pack priority. The named regional and larger botanical rosters are pending parent research. Existing eastern/general candidates are preserved without a local-native claim. American crow and common raven remain distinct, explicitly labelled North American starter assumptions; generation is owned by a separate worker.

Actual local generation-call durations:34.7,40.9,47.2 and28.4seconds. The tracker estimates30–90seconds for another six-pose candidate at low confidence; artistic correction and Mac integration remain unestimated. Ten local tracker-browser checks passed with zero page errors; four animation packages passed unique-frame, decode and exact source-crop checks. These do not establish anatomical quality or app integration.

No image call or hidden background process is running at this checkpoint. Next local queued batch is `rain-continuity-v2`, using the retained rain source to improve temporal tracking/loop quality. Canonical dove identity/contact correction and Mac staging await parent handoff. No source repository was edited, committed or pushed.

# house-finch-female-feed-v1 — reviewed candidate

- Seed/kernel is oversized and pickup/crushing contact timing is illustrative; no resolved shell-splitting acceptance.
- Feeding posture is a head/neck bow; ordinary ground walking/hopping amplitude is a separate requested behavior.
